title: 土地、建造与运营成本
prompt: Black-and-white observational documentary footage for a serious economics explainer. Neutral grayscale silver-gelatin photography, detailed faces and material textures, soft daylight, moderate contrast, clear readable composition. Original illustrative reconstruction. Natural restrained gestures, physically coherent objects and hands. Landscape 16:9. One continuous shot, gentle camera movement only. No subtitles, no readable lettering, no logos, no watermark, no graphic overlays. Close tabletop documentary shot of an East Asian property finance analyst's hands sorting three folders beside a calculator, a small ordinary office building model, a construction material sample and a site plan. She calculates on the calculator, then checks a folder. Blank or indistinct document text, no readable numbers. Keep hands and objects stable and realistic.
